units.previous_finding: example:concurrency/exercise-equivalent-binary-trees.go: The Same comment uses a fák t1 és t2, an unnatural Hungarian word order that leaves the relation of t1/t2 to the two trees awkward and unclear. Revise only the natural-language comment to state clearly that Same determines whether trees t1 and t2 contain the same values; preserve all code and identifiers.

example:concurrency/exercise-web-crawler.go: The Fetch and TODO comments repeatedly use the placeholder-style Hungarian article a(z) URL; published Hungarian prose needs context-appropriate articles. URL törzsét can suggest that the URL string itself has a body, rather than content returned for that URL; the phrase feltöltött fakeFetcher is also awkward for a pre-populated fetcher. Improve these natural-language comments without changing URL targets, code, symbols, or implementation semantics.
